notes.title: Creating No Strangers 2.0 From Scratch
notes.content:
Hello,

You may know me as Xeirel. Today, I’d like to share my thoughts with you not just as a game developer, but also as a fellow player.
This post is packed with updates and details — but most importantly, it’s about how I’ve started rebuilding No Strangers from scratch.

🎮 The First Birth of No Strangers
Originally, No Strangers was a test project I started during university. I had some experience with Unity, but I had never developed a multiplayer game before. Back then, although Mirror Networking was easier to learn, I chose to use Unity’s Netcode for GameObjects.

Throughout development, I tried to learn, experiment, and implement features by trial and error. Unfortunately, over time this caused the project to become overly complex and nearly impossible to maintain. Looking back at my old source code... I often can’t even tell what I was thinking 😅

Thankfully, I’ve gained a lot of experience since then.

💼 Other game: Digital Market Simulator
During this time, I began working on another game called Digital Market Simulator with two close friends. Because of that, I couldn’t focus on No Strangers for a while.

But now I’ve created a new project and officially started working on No Strangers 2.0 from scratch!

To summarize, here are the main differences between the old version (No Strangers 1.0 - Legacy) and the new one (No Strangers 2.0 - WIP), including added and planned features:

✅ NEW FEATURES
🌍 Multiple playable maps
👤 Custom player models can now be loaded (Steam Workshop support is planned)
🧭 Revamped UI system — Main menu and pause menu are now unified
🔒 Advanced authentication system:

Players who fail Steam authentication
Players who don’t have the server password
Players you personally block
→ All of them are strictly denied access. A highly secure system is in place.

🚶‍♂️ Client-Side Prediction Movement
Player movement is simulated both on client and server, then synchronized.
→ This prevents speed hacks and unfair lag-related issues.

👀 Spectator Mode
You can now join ongoing games as a spectator.

🎮 GameMode System
Create your own game modes with unique rules.
Adjust spawn behavior, movement types, and more.
→ You’re no longer limited to classic No Strangers gameplay — sandbox and experimental modes are now possible!

🎙️ New Voice Chat System

Old system used Steam’s voice infra and RPC for transmission (which caused delay and lag).

Now:
Audio is captured directly from the device
Noise is reduced using rnnoise
Encoded via Opus
Sent in packets, decoded by recipients
→ In testing, performance was very close to Discord (even better with lower latency 💀).

🔜 PLANNED FEATURES
🔧 Mod API
The game source will remain closed, but I plan to offer a Lua-based custom API for modding.

🎒 Advanced inventory system
Items, clothing, weapons, and more can be stored.
Can be disabled depending on the game mode.

🤖 AI Players
Both offline and online AI players will be supported.
They can act as teammates or enemies.

🚀 Optimization
Better 3D models, more efficient occlusion culling.
→ Strong focus on performance.

📢 ABOUT DEVELOPMENT
This time, I’m not rushing anything. I want to build a solid and scalable foundation for the game.

I’ll share screenshots and videos occasionally, and I plan to do community polls to collect feedback on specific features.

👉 You can join our Discord server or follow my upcoming Patreon page for updates and behind-the-scenes posts.

I’m not a millionaire, nor a famous developer. The only way I can be heard... is with your help.
I’d love to see you in our community. 🙏

🧪 BETA TESTING
As development progresses, we’ll begin a beta testing phase.
I’ll be inviting volunteer testers from the community.

Super excited for this part! 🧡

❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (Q&A)
Q: Will it be released as a separate game?
A: No, it will be released as an update. You’ll still be able to play the legacy version via beta branches.
Q: Will it still just have the classic mode and map?
A: No. Thanks to the new GameMode system, new modes and maps will be added over time.
Q: Will there be Steam Workshop support?
A: Yes, it’s one of my goals and I plan to implement it.
Q: Will the classic “Who is the Killer?” mode change?
A: Yes. New roles and gameplay mechanics will be introduced.
Q: Can I play solo?
A: Yes. Single-player compatible modes and AI players will be supported.
Q: When will version 2.0 be released?
A: I can’t give a specific date, but some of the core systems are done. I’ll keep sharing updates on Discord and Steam.
Q: Will cosmetic DLCs still be usable?
A: Yes.
Q: Will the game’s atmosphere change?
A: Yes. Graphics, sound, and ambiance will be more immersive. I want players to feel like they’re part of the world.
Q: Will system requirements change?
A: No.
Q: Will it support Steam Deck and Linux?
A: Yes, it will be playable on platforms like Steam Deck and Linux.

Q: Where the hell are the Discord Server and Patreon links??
A: Right here Discord Server and Patreon 🥀

notes.title: We Need Your Help!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋

We are small indie team named Xeirel Software, and we want to thank you once again for making No Strangers project way bigger than we ever expected.

Now we’re working on something new...

🎮 Digital Market Simulator 
A relaxing yet deep simulator where you manage your own tech & game store — selling consoles etc, decorating your place 👀

We're super excited about it — but as you know, getting visibility on Steam is tough.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3605520

Thanks for being part of our journey. Your support means everything.

- Xeirel

notes.title: 04.12.2024 - 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Changes

Fixed the number of players in the lobby showing incorrectly in the server list.
Added an interface that shows the remaining time if weapons are locked or on cooldown.
Increased the duration of informational messages at the start of the game.
Fixed overlapping of interface elements.
Added a guide interface that will appear to the lobby owner when the game has not started.
Improved text chat.
Adjustments to ambient sounds.

notes.title: 25.11.2024 1.0.5b2 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.content:
Changes

 Fixed formatting and staying focused in text chat.
 Fixed some control assignments not being valid.
 Fixed an issue with being able to start the game alone.
 Characters now take damage from hitboxes on their bodies, removed the old capsule collider.
 Fixed motion blur setting not being valid.
 Fixed Japanese and some other translations (thanks to @arthRo)
 You can now see the latency between you and the host/server in the top left label.

Developer Note
Right now I've started to fix a lot of things to make the game more dynamic, like being able to play different maps, or customize the rules more. Thank you for playing.

notes.title: 19.11.2024 1.0.5 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.content:
Changes

 You can now view and edit button assignments in-game by clicking the “Button Configuration” button from the “Settings” menu.
 You can now view the people you have blocked from your lobbies, view their profiles or unblock them from the “Server Variables” menu.
 Profile photos can now appear in the player list in the pause menu, and you can view players' Steam Profiles by clicking on their names.
 Added text chat. When your player is alive, you can text chat with players within 20 meters of you, and if you are dead, you can text chat with other dead players.
 Fixed some parts of the player not showing up in the killer view.
 Fixed player's speech icons not showing up in some situations.

Developer Note
In the survey we conducted with valuable players on our Discord server, the concept of “Abandoned hospital map” as a new map idea resulted in a majority of votes. I will be coming soon with a new map and improved gameplay, so stay tuned and join us!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/5GDJ53ZKyq

notes.title: 14.11.2024 1.0.3 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.content:
Changes

Fixed fonts in Japanese and other languages.
HOST players can now update certain lobby variables while in the waiting area.
In the player list in the pause menu, you can see which players are talking, dead/alive.
Fixed a bug where you could climb on trees.
Prevented players' locations from being revealed from some locations on the map.
Fixed a bug where players who were jumping high when the game ended would suddenly die when the game restarted.
Turned off keyboard control of some interface elements.
Improved the interface of the pause menu.
Fixed a game crash caused by the spectator camera when everyone is dead.
People banned by the host player are now saved, so newly opened lobbies will keep the same data.
Added an option to the settings for motion blur.

Developer Note
I was unable to push updates due to the Steam Guard restriction, with this update you can now experience version 1.0.3. Feel free to let me know any bugs you encounter. I'll be slowly moving on to more fun features, you're invited to our Discord server for polls and to join us.

I also decided to keep the game free for a while longer, thanks to everyone who played and enjoyed <3

notes.title: 03.11.2024 Update Log + Developer Note
notes.content:
Changes

Added crouching to the character controller.
Fixed a bug that allowed you to make physical contact with the Siren cosmetic.
Fixed the shape of the stream on the map.
UI sounds have been fixed.
Speech icon can now appear on character names.
Slightly changed the lighting and design on the map.
Added a new security system, our security team will monitor the servers and permanently ban toxic/cheating players.

I value your thoughts and ideas, dear friends. I'd appreciate it if you criticize the game in the community section and the review section. I keep the game constantly updated and I usually play my own game, so maybe you can even come across me in the game 😁

(We may even be lurking among you).

SEE YOU ON THE NEXT UPDATE!

notes.title: 31.10.2024 Update Log + Developer Note + Anti Cheat
notes.content:
Changes

 New Anti-Cheat System

Developer Note
I am aware of the cheaters who spoil your fun in the game you enter for fun and I am largely preventing them in this update. Sorry for being late.

And I have a message for the cheaters:
We don't have any rank system, you have nothing to gain, so why are you just trying to disrupt the peace in a game where people play to cheer up a little bit when they are sad and troubled? This is not cool guys, if you are interested in such things, use it for something more useful. You have no right to spoil people's joy.

notes.title: 30.10.2024 Update Log 3 + IMPORTANT DEVELOPER NOTE
notes.content:
Hello!
Sorry for flooding you guys with updates, but I have good news, I REALLY fixed the spawning of weapons. Yes, my friends and I tested it many times and everything was great. Please forgive me, I'm trying to keep up with everything all day long on my own. I also want to thank everyone in the community for their moral support, you guys are like family to me.

The version has changed, so some of the servers may remain on the old version, they will be migrated to the new version.

Love you all <3

notes.title: 30.10.2024 Update Log 2 + Developer Note
notes.content:
Changes

Removed fade effects from player names.

Developer Note
It's hard to believe, but the names on the characters were the main cause of the game's lag, especially in alphabets like Chinese, it was reloading the TMP Text component every frame, so we were experiencing a huge framerate drop. To solve this, we removed the fade effect of the names, and in technical terms, we made sure that if the variables are the same, they will not reload. So you will no longer experience lag. I've tried it and I approve it.

Hello, dear players,

I'm currently developing the game on my own, but I'm still working hard to shape the game based on your feedback. In the next update, there will be some changes that will please players who want to be able to play the game with few people or on their own.

I'm trying to make the game as fun, different and accessible as possible. To help me reach more players, you can share the game with your friends and share your objective thoughts on the game as a review.
